features.value: Shareholder register, certificates, group companies and documents

texts: AXA is one of the largest insurance groups in the world. In Spain it offers home, health, life, car and business insurance through its network of offices and agents.
A group of its size has shareholders and several companies in Spain that need their certificates up to date and error-free.
